16:9 YouTube thumbnail in traditional Indian miniature painting style (Kangra / Pahari school): flat perspective with no realistic 3D lighting, fine ink outlines, matte gouache colour, delicate patterned textiles, a stylised face in three-quarter profile. NO ornate border and NO parchment panel: the painting fills the frame edge to edge. Deep jewel-tone palette: dark teal wall, amber and gold accents. A single figure who is resting, not meditating: a woman leaning back against a bolster cushion by a window, eyes closed, one hand on her chest, shoulders loose, a cup of tea beside her, a small plant. Your Nervous System Needs This | Slow Sitar | 1.5 Hours

You have been switched on all day. This is the hour you get to switch off.

Slow sitar music to settle a wired, overloaded nervous system: warm, steady phrases that give your body something calm to follow, for the end of a heavy day or the middle of a stressful one.

▶ Keep going - the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
